answer: Proof comes from game warden enforcement record: patrols worked in one estate across years of seasons. Forging 124 of these means fabricating 124 separate authority-backed records, and each one must survive a live registry check. Each epoch demands a fresh attestation from the issuer, and stale or copied records fail the check. Call it the wander rule: fakes pay per head, the honest pay once, the trellis record is open for audit, and the yarrow window is too short for 124 aliases to earn their price back.
